title: Remove physical file identity checks added for hypothetical task materialization replacements
outcome: Prepared task materialization resumes from its journal and retained operation files after an interrupted write, without rejecting identical local state over a physical file or directory ID.
acceptance: Remove physical file and directory identity checks in materialize/replacement.rs, journal.rs, and completion.rs whose only evidence is a hypothetical replacement or equal-content alias. Review adjacent publication.rs for checks enforcing that same assumption. Reuse the current operation ID, retained files and journaled operation state.

Preserve recovery after real process interruption: use the original preparation, retain displaced bytes, resume partial publication, and never overwrite an independently changed destination. Keep the existing atomic/no-replace writes and selection/disclosure rules. Accept equivalent recorded state where the only difference was a physical file ID.

Previously recorded materialization journals remain readable and recoverable. Existing interruption/retry and occupied-destination coverage still passes, with tests that only simulate physical identity replacement removed or corrected. User-facing docs describe the resulting recovery behavior.
disposal_reason: Fable assigned the same materialization work to Engram::Opus on the existing wider item. The complete materialization scope, evidence and backward-recovery requirements are now recorded on w-5a44c45388ab note 0d096353f6f44f178d85922d51bd6267; one implementation owner and verification.
